label: prf:qou-is-ccc
title: Proof of qou is ccc
html:
Proof. Proof of qou is ccc

Proof. (CCC-1) constitutes the content of conformal invariance at the jet horizon.

(CCC-2) follows from the definition of aeon adjacency (aeon). Adjacent aeons share the boundary \mathcal{S}_b. The CMB of the successor aeon is exactly the degree \geq 1 data at its past boundary, which is the shared locus \mathcal{S}_b.

(CCC-3) follows from the definition of a jet horizon (jet horizon). The defining condition is A_0|_{\mathcal{H}} = 0. The Frobenius non-degeneracy axiom requires A_0 \neq 0 for well-defined degree-0 observations. At the boundary where A_0 = 0, the pairing degenerates. Consequently, degree-0 data is unobservable. \square

Limitations of the claim. The proposition establishes that a QOU containing aeons is structurally a CCC. It does not claim that any particular affine chart admits aeons (a dynamical question). It does not claim that the aeon chain is infinite. Finally, it does not adopt Penrose's specific conformal metric rescaling g \mapsto \Omega^2 g; the QOU mechanism is ideal vanishing.
